description: This file implements string map data structures and related operations, including initialization, insertion, lookup, removal, and clearing of string-based hash maps and sets. It provides internal utilities for managing entries, comparison, and memory handling, supporting features like string duplication and memory pooling.

methods.name: int cmp_strmap_entry(const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * entry1,const struct hashmap_entry * entry2,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for hashmap entries based on string keys.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * find_strmap_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Finds a hashmap entry in 'map' with a given string key.

methods.name: void strmap_init(struct strmap * map)
methods.description: Initializes a strmap to default state.

methods.name: void strmap_init_with_options(struct strmap * map,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initializes a strmap with specified memory pool and string duplication option.

methods.name: void strmap_free_entries_(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Frees entries in the strmap, optionally freeing their values.

methods.name: void strmap_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Clears all entries in the strmap, freeing memory as needed.

methods.name: void strmap_partial_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Partially clears strmap entries, freeing resources accordingly.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * create_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Creates a new hashmap entry with provided string and data, handling string duplication and memory allocation.

methods.name: void * strmap_put(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Inserts or updates the value associated with a string key in the map.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * strmap_get_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the internal hashmap entry for a given string key.

methods.name: void * strmap_get(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a string key.

methods.name: int strmap_contains(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks if a string key exists in the map.

methods.name: void strmap_remove(struct strmap * map,const char * str,int free_value)
methods.description: Removes an entry with the specified string key from the map.

methods.name: void strintmap_incr(struct strintmap * map,const char * str,intptr_t amt)
methods.description: Increments the integer value associated with a string key.

methods.name: int strset_add(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Adds a string to a set, represented as a strmap.
